title: Access problem codes
description: Stable RFC 9457 problem codes of the shared HTTP stack and the management API (OP-65, OP-149 m.12).

codes.title: Not Found
codes.description: No such resource, or one the caller may not see (TN-113).

codes.title: Internal Server Error
codes.description: A server failure; details stay in the logs.

codes.title: Service Unavailable
codes.description: A dependency is unavailable; nothing was decided or changed (MD-8).

codes.title: Not Implemented
codes.description: The route is declared in the Frontend API and not served yet; nothing was read or changed (OP-153 m.4).

codes.title: Bad Request
codes.description: The request path is not in its one canonical spelling (TN-113).

codes.title: Payload Too Large
codes.description: The request body exceeds the limit (R-5).

codes.title: Method Not Allowed
codes.description: The method is not served on this path.

codes.title: Too Many Requests
codes.description: A rate limit was reached; the RateLimit and Retry-After headers say when to retry (TN-127).

codes.title: Bad Request
codes.description: A mutating request carries no Idempotency-Key (TN-126).

codes.title: Bad Request
codes.description: The Idempotency-Key is empty, longer than 255 characters or not visible ASCII (TN-126).

codes.title: Bad Request
codes.description: The Idempotency-Key of a write is its AIS nonce, unpadded base64url (TN-126).

codes.title: Idempotency-Key reused with another request
codes.description: The Idempotency-Key already ran another request (TN-126, TI-8).

codes.title: A request with this Idempotency-Key is still running
codes.description: The first request under the Idempotency-Key is still running (TN-126).

codes.title: Precondition Required
codes.description: An update must carry If-Match with the resource's ETag (OP-65).

codes.title: Precondition Failed
codes.description: If-Match does not name the resource's current ETag (OP-65).

codes.title: Bad Request
codes.description: The filter is outside the SCIM subset: eq, ne, co, sw, pr, and, or, parentheses (TN-112).

codes.title: Bad Request
codes.description: The filter names an attribute the endpoint does not filter on; it is never ignored (TN-112).

codes.title: Bad Request
codes.description: The filter exceeds its size, depth or term limits (CR-10).

codes.title: Bad Request
codes.description: The cursor was not issued by this list (OP-65).

codes.title: Bad Request
codes.description: page[size] must be an integer from 1 to 100 (§13.7.4).

codes.title: Bad Request
codes.description: A query parameter the endpoint does not take, or one given twice.

codes.title: Bad Request
codes.description: The body is not a JSON Merge Patch the resource takes (RFC 7396).

codes.title: Bad Request
codes.description: The request is malformed.

codes.title: Unauthorized
codes.description: No usable read token: missing, bearer, malformed, expired, revoked or not holder-bound (TN-27, TN-130).

codes.title: Unauthorized
codes.description: The token's audience is another management surface (TN-119).

codes.title: Unauthorized
codes.description: Management read tokens live at most 60 minutes (OP-151 m.3 (c)).

codes.title: Forbidden
codes.description: The token lacks the route's scope (TN-113).

codes.title: Unauthorized
codes.description: A write carries the caller's AIS; no token writes (TN-110, TN-130).

codes.title: Unauthorized
codes.description: The AIS is not a well-formed, signed actor intent statement (PI-7).

codes.title: Forbidden
codes.description: The AIS does not verify with a live Instance key of this surface's domain, or names another domain or mode (PI-7, TN-119).

codes.title: Forbidden
codes.description: The Exercise the write compiled to was decided and not allowed; nothing changed (TN-110).

codes.title: Bad Request
codes.description: The Exercise the write compiled to was refused before a decision; nothing changed (TN-110).

codes.title: Bad Request
codes.description: The body is not the operation's JSON object, or names a member the operation does not take.

codes.title: Bad Request
codes.description: The write's intent validity is missing, malformed, inverted or longer than 15 minutes (TN-110).

codes.title: Bad Request
codes.description: A client_id that is not one the server generated (OP-137, TN-15).

codes.title: Bad Request
codes.description: An empty, too long or control-character display name.

codes.title: Bad Request
codes.description: A redirect URI that is not an exact, absolute, allowed URI, or too many (IDP-7, RFC 9700).

codes.title: Bad Request
codes.description: A JWKS URI that is not https, or an authentication method without the fields it needs.

codes.title: Bad Request
codes.description: A host name that is not a lower-case DNS name.

codes.title: Bad Request
codes.description: A claim name that is reserved or names authority (must-never #18, P55).

codes.title: Bad Request
codes.description: A profile attribute outside the OpenID Connect standard claims (§9.9.6).

codes.title: Bad Request
codes.description: Argon2 parameters may only be raised (OP-33).

codes.title: Bad Request
codes.description: An RP ID that is not the issuer's host or a parent domain of it (WebAuthn §5.1.4).

codes.title: Bad Request
codes.description: Platform product fields are not written on the realm-admin surface (OP-149 m.4).

codes.title: Bad Request
codes.description: A public key that is not a usable Ed25519 or P-256 key, or a client key that is not P-256 (MD-3).

codes.title: Bad Request
codes.description: An event receiver that is not an https URL Access may push to (OP-149 m.23).

codes.title: Bad Request
codes.description: Branding outside its fields' shapes, or a logo outside its CSP origins (TN-106).

codes.title: Bad Request
codes.description: A Related Origins list that is not https origins, names more than five registrable labels with the RP ID, or an origin outside the realm's verified domains (TN-18, OP-153 m.3 (u)).

codes.title: Bad Request
codes.description: Message overrides naming a protected or unknown key, or text that is not plain (X35, XI-25, OP-153 m.3 (s)).

codes.title: Bad Request
codes.description: A key rotation policy the realm may not take (CR-26, TN-118).

codes.title: Bad Request
codes.description: A group or upstream name outside ^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,63}$.

codes.title: Bad Request
codes.description: A membership issuer that is not admin or upstream:<name>, or one that would change (TN-117).

codes.title: Bad Request
codes.description: No members, or more than 100 in one change.

codes.title: Bad Request
codes.description: An upstream registration outside its fields' shapes; its secret is a secret:// reference, never the secret (OP-150 m.11 (j)).

codes.title: Bad Request
codes.description: An upstream subject that is empty, longer than 255 bytes or has control characters.

codes.title: Conflict
codes.description: The upstream subject is linked to another account; a link is never moved (TN-42).

codes.title: Bad Request
codes.description: Sign-in requirements outside their shapes (TN-132).

codes.title: Bad Request
codes.description: A console session policy beyond 12 hours absolute or 15 minutes idle, or without a binding (TN-129, OP-151 m.3 (f)).

codes.title: Conflict
codes.description: A resource with this natural key exists, or existed and was retired; keys are never reused (OP-73).

codes.title: Conflict
codes.description: The group's members are issued by an upstream provider, not by the administration (TN-117).

codes.title: Conflict
codes.description: The account is not in a state the change leaves (§12.3.1, TN-49).

codes.title: Conflict
codes.description: The client does not authenticate with a secret (CR-38).

codes.title: Conflict
codes.description: An RP ID change makes the realm's registered passkeys unusable; acknowledge_passkey_loss must equal their count (IDI-4).

codes.title: Conflict
codes.description: The resource changed while the write was applied; nothing changed.

codes.title: Bad Request
codes.description: The operation named is not a realm write operation.

codes.title: Bad Request
codes.description: A placement outside `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,62}$` (OP-40).

codes.title: Bad Request
codes.description: The founding root names no Party, or is a joint root with k below 2 or above its Parties; Joint(k >= 2) is recommended (TN-111, §13.7.7).

codes.title: Bad Request
codes.description: A sole founding root cannot be recovered; the request must carry acknowledge_no_recovery: true (TN-111, TN-60, §13.7.7).

codes.title: Bad Request
codes.description: The CT3 time-lock is outside one hour to thirty days (OP-141 m.34 (d)).

codes.title: Conflict
codes.description: The slug is taken, now or by a deleted realm; slugs are never reused (TN-16, INV-32).

codes.title: Bad Request
codes.description: A client reads pairwise subs unless subject_type is public and public_sub_opt_in is true (MD-10).

codes.title: Bad Request
codes.description: The sector_identifier_uri is not https, or its document is not a JSON array of https URIs listing every redirect URI (OIDC Core 8.1).

codes.title: Not Implemented
codes.description: The operation is declared in the catalogue and reserved; it is never applied (OP-150 m.11 (b)).

codes.title: Bad Request
codes.description: The realm signs with ES256 or Ed25519; EdDSA is never named (MD-3, CR-5).

codes.title: Bad Request
codes.description: Certificate sign-in names its rule (san_email or san_upn), 1 to 16 distinct CA certificates as base64url DER of at most 8 KB while on, and at most 16 issuer policy OIDs in dotted form (OP-155 m.3 (m)).

codes.title: Bad Request
codes.description: Each protection is monitor or enforce, sl2 is shadow, stepup or stepup_caep, at most 1024 nonzero denied ASNs; brute-force protection is always enforce (OP-151 m.3 (o), TI-9).

codes.title: Bad Request
codes.description: A job is {mode: sequential or parallel, operations: 1 to 100 items of {operation, key, if_match, body with its ais}} (TN-125).

codes.title: Bad Request
codes.description: A job item is a realm write whose answer may be kept; a write that shows a secret once is sent on its own (TN-125, CR-38).

codes.title: Bad Request
codes.description: The job's AIS does not sign the digest of its mode and items; draft it with POST intents (TN-110, TN-125).

codes.title: Failed Dependency
codes.description: An earlier item of the sequential job did not commit, so this one was not run (TN-125).

codes.title: Bad Request
codes.description: A hook or webhook URL that is not https on a DNS name, or a private target the realm does not allow or the operator did not declare (OP-151 m.10 (e), OP-149 m.23).

codes.title: Bad Request
codes.description: A hook registration outside its call point's contract (TN-135).

codes.title: Bad Request
codes.description: A hook asks for personal data the realm's extension policy does not permit (OP-151 m.10 (e)).

codes.title: Bad Request
codes.description: Webhook events outside the identity event catalogue (TN-136).

codes.title: Bad Request
codes.description: An extension policy outside its shape (OP-151 m.10 (e)).

codes.title: Conflict
codes.description: The call point has a live hook already; retire it first (OP-151 m.10 (d)).

codes.title: Conflict
codes.description: The realm does not accept this action's catalog yet; its catalog upgrade must commit first (OP-153 m.3 (a)).

codes.title: Conflict
codes.description: The organization keeps at least one active owner on every path; add another owner first (TN-91).

codes.title: Bad Request
codes.description: The agent is malformed: an unknown kind, an operator that is no live organization or person, a bad name or description, or no distinct active sponsor (OP-154 m.3 (c), (e)).

codes.title: Bad Request
codes.description: An agent Grant template needs its budget (a count per window, and for consumption a cap per intent and a daily window), at most one delegation hop and no core meta-action (OP-154 m.3 (g), RR-12).

codes.title: Bad Request
codes.description: A workload client names a SPIFFE ID or a whole-segment prefix ending in /*, an https Bundle Endpoint and its agent, and no redirect URI (OP-154 m.3 (r), §11.12.1).

codes.title: Bad Request
codes.description: The vault Resource is malformed: an upstream the catalog does not have or an own upstream outside the catalog format, a client secret that is not a secret:// reference, a scope the upstream does not offer, a mapped action outside the Resource's scopes or in the access or idp namespaces, or an executor that is not a certificate thumbprint (OP-154 m.3 (t)).

codes.title: Bad Request
codes.description: The SAML service provider registration is malformed: an entity ID that is not a bounded URI, an ACS that is not exact https or not HTTP-POST, a certificate that is not base64 DER, signed requests without a pinned certificate, encryption without an encryption certificate, nothing signed, an e-mail NameID without a template that asks for it, a duplicated attribute, or a registration its template's profile refuses (OP-155 m.3 (e)).

codes.title: Conflict
codes.description: A SAML service provider with this name or entity ID was registered before; a retired registration's name and entity ID are never reused (OP-73).

codes.title: Bad Request
codes.description: The SAML certificate policy keeps each rotation phase at least 14 days, rotates every 30 to 1825 days and names rsa-3072 or p-256 (OP-155 m.3 (e)).

codes.title: Bad Request
codes.description: The gateway registration needs a kind (saml, ldap, kerberos or radius), a name of lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, and the SHA-256 of its client certificate in hex; only a live gateway can be retired (OP-155 m.3 (c)).

codes.title: Bad Request
codes.description: A custom domain is a lower-case host below a registrable domain, outside the deployment's base domain and never localhost; one bound as the issuer or passkey RP ID is never retired (OP-156 m.3 (i)).

codes.title: Bad Request
codes.description: An export sink has a lower-case name, an adapter (s3_parquet, otlp, collector or syslog), an https endpoint on port 443 or one the operator declared (host:port on 6514 for syslog), the settings of its adapter or preset and, where the adapter needs one, a secret; no sampling or filter setting exists (OP-156 m.3 (s), OP-44).

codes.title: Conflict
codes.description: An export sink with this name was registered before; a retired sink keeps its name and its cursor (OP-73).

codes.title: Conflict
codes.description: The realm's issuer moves to a custom domain only before its first client or service provider is registered, and only from a subdomain issuer (TN-16, OP-156 m.3 (i)).

codes.title: Conflict
codes.description: The organization's SCIM source answers for its membership, so it takes no invitation; members come and go through the SCIM client (TN-95).

codes.title: Bad Request
codes.description: The setup link order names an address that is not an e-mail address (TN-134).

codes.title: Bad Request
codes.description: A protected resource is a canonical https URI without query, fragment or trailing slash, and a display name of 1 to 128 printable characters (AG-8, RFC 8707 §2).

codes.title: Bad Request
codes.description: A DCR policy names whether registration is open, at most 64 redirect domains and at most 16 initial access tokens as unpadded base64url SHA-256 digests; an open policy names at least one (OP-154 m.3 (j)).

codes.title: Bad Request
codes.description: A client profile names FAPI 2.0 only for a confidential private_key_jwt or mutual TLS client without RS256 or the bearer exception, client_secret_post only over a registered secret, an ID token algorithm the realm serves, an encryption key for ECDH-ES+A256KW or RSA-OAEP-256 and something to encrypt, or an upstream by name (OP-155 m.3 (k)).

codes.title: Bad Request
codes.description: A cross-app connection names a slug, a registered client, the Resource authorization server's issuer and the resource there as canonical https URIs, at most 64 scopes as a hint, and the pairwise subject policy (OP-154 m.3 (n), AG-28).

codes.title: Bad Request
codes.description: A recovery policy outside its ranges, or a cooling entry below the floor of the realm default (TN-55, OP-153 m.3 (e)).

codes.title: Conflict
codes.description: The realm does not allow temporary access passes, or the account turned assisted recovery off (TN-60, TN-62).

codes.title: Forbidden
codes.description: Nobody issues a reset intent or a temporary access pass for their own account (TN-62).

codes.title: Conflict
codes.description: The Party is not a live organization Party of the realm's governing domain (OP-153 m.3 (b)).

codes.title: Bad Request
codes.description: An invitee address, inviter name, role or lifetime outside the rules (TN-89, OP-153 m.3 (o)).

codes.title: Conflict
codes.description: Home realm discovery goes on only with a verified domain no other organization claims (TN-98).

codes.title: Bad Request
codes.description: The preset is not one Access ships, or the client id and secret reference are not given together (IDP-31).

codes.title: Conflict
codes.description: Only a sandbox realm may use the shared development client; give the realm its own client id and secret reference (IDP-31).

codes.title: Forbidden
codes.description: The account is in the grace period after a recovery; deleting it, a new client secret, an identity provider link and the other restricted changes wait until it ends (TN-56, OP-153 m.3 (e)).

codes.title: Bad Request
codes.description: A domain that is not a lower-case DNS name, or a verification method other than dns_txt, https or idp (TN-90).

codes.title: Conflict
codes.description: Autojoin is refused on a consumer, free mail, ISP or university domain (TN-90).

codes.title: Conflict
codes.description: Another organization claims the domain too, so none of them gets autojoin (TN-90).

codes.title: Conflict
codes.description: The organization's claim of the domain is not verified now (TN-90).

codes.title: Bad Request
codes.description: A connection draft whose issuer is not an https URL or whose client id is empty or too long (TN-120).

codes.title: Bad Request
codes.description: An audit stream rendering other than ocsf, cef or set (OP-41).

codes.title: Forbidden
codes.description: Only an owner proposes or completes an ownership handover, and only its own client signs it (TN-91).

codes.title: Conflict
codes.description: The handover waits for its recipient's contribution or its 24-hour delay (TN-91).

codes.title: Conflict
codes.description: The signed change is not this organization's handover to that recipient (TN-91).

codes.title: Gone
codes.description: The message's sealed content was crypto-shredded, so it cannot be resent; nothing was written (OP-156 m.3 (c)).

codes.title: Conflict
codes.description: The message is past its expiry, so it is not resent; start the flow that sends it again (OP-156 m.3 (c)).

codes.title: Bad Request
codes.description: The SSH CA change is `{"enabled": true}` or `{"enabled": false}`; a rotation or a replacement has an empty body (OP-156 m.3 (o)).

codes.title: Bad Request
codes.description: The SSH server group needs a name of a lower-case letter followed by up to 62 lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, and a description of at most 256 characters (OP-156 m.3 (o)).

codes.title: Conflict
codes.description: An SSH server group with this name was registered before; a retired group's name is never reused (OP-73).

codes.title: Conflict
codes.description: The realm's SSH certificate authority is off, so no certificate is issued and no CA key is published; an administrator turns it on with idp.ssh.ca_enable (OP-156 m.3 (o)).

codes.title: Forbidden
codes.description: No live ssh.login Grant of the caller covers this server group with these principals, constraints and extensions, or the server group is not live; a certificate never carries more than its Grant (IDP-32).

codes.title: Bad Request
codes.description: A person's certificate lives at most 12 hours and an agent's at most 1 hour, never past the Grant or the horizon (OP-156 m.3 (o)).

codes.title: Bad Request
codes.description: The request is a draft ask {host_group, public_key, principals?, lifetime_s?} or a signed draft {draft, ais}; the AIS is signed by the key the access token is bound to (OP-156 m.3 (o)).

codes.title: Forbidden
codes.description: The authority decision on the certificate's projection.issue is not ALLOW: it was denied or waits on an action such as a fresh sign-in or an approval; the decision is in `decision` (OP-156 m.3 (o)).

codes.title: Bad Request
codes.description: The proxy needs a name of a lower-case letter followed by up to 62 lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, an engine of nginx, traefik, caddy or envoy, an application host, an http(s) upstream, a client_id, the proxy's transport identity (the base64url of its certificate or DPoP key thumbprint), an action, a resource namespace and 1 to 64 path patterns (OP-156 m.3 (l)).

codes.title: Conflict
codes.description: A proxy with this name was registered before; a retired proxy's name is never reused (OP-73).

codes.title: Bad Request
codes.description: The proxy's client_id names no live client of the realm that lists https://{host}/access-proxy/v1/callback as a redirect URI (OP-156 m.3 (l)).

codes.title: Conflict
codes.description: The setup check reached the application's upstream directly, so anyone could send it X-Access-User; plain identity headers stay off until the application answers only through the proxy (IDP-30 (3), OP-156 m.3 (l)).

codes.title: Unauthorized
codes.description: The forward-auth check came without a proxy transport identity, or none registered for this application host; register the proxy with idp.proxy.register (IDP-30, OP-156 m.3 (l)).

codes.title: Bad Request
codes.description: The forward-auth check does not name the request it asks about: the engine's method, URI and host headers are missing or malformed; the request is refused (OP-156 m.3 (l)).

codes.title: Bad Request
codes.description: A Linux host has a name and a live server group of a lower-case letter followed by up to 62 lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, the 43-character x5t#S256 of its client certificate, an absolute shell path and sudo at CT2 or CT3; it serves NSS data offline for at most 12 hours and reuses a console sign-in offline for at most 8 (OP-156 m.3 (p)).

codes.title: Conflict
codes.description: A Linux host with this name was registered before, or a live host presents this client certificate; a retired host's name is never reused (OP-73).

codes.title: Forbidden
codes.description: The request did not come with the client certificate of a live Linux host of this realm, registered with idp.linux.host_register (OP-156 m.3 (p)).

codes.title: Bad Request
codes.description: The Linux NSS request is an empty JSON object; a sign-in is {user}, a sudo step-up {user, command} with the base64url SHA-256 of the command line, each with the person's DPoP-bound access token (OP-156 m.3 (p)).

codes.title: Forbidden
codes.description: sudo needs a sign-in in the last 5 minutes with a phishing-resistant, user-verifying authenticator (CT2; CT3 also device-bound and non-custodial); a push or a password alone is not enough (IDP-8, OP-156 m.3 (p)).

codes.title: Bad Request
codes.description: The HR source needs a name of a lower-case letter followed by up to 62 lower-case letters, digits and hyphens; a retirement has an empty body (OP-156 m.3 (q)).

codes.title: Conflict
codes.description: An HR source with this name was registered before; a retired source's name and issuer are never reused (OP-73).

codes.title: Bad Request
codes.description: The HR connector needs a name, the HR source it pushes to and a vendor services/hr-connector reads: personio, bamboohr, hibob, workday, successfactors, kolayik or logo (OP-156 m.3 (q)).

codes.title: Conflict
codes.description: An HR connector with this name was registered before; a retired connector's name is never reused (OP-73).

codes.title: Bad Request
codes.description: The import is {file, records, content}: content is 1 to 10 000 JSON Lines records or an RFC 4180 CSV file of at most 10 MB with a header row of employee_id, email, department, title, manager, start_date, end_date and employment_status, file its SHA-256 and records its record count. One bad record, an unknown column or a digest or count that does not match refuses the whole file and nothing is written (OP-156 m.3 (q)).
